subject: The King is dead
body:
You beat the King! I can't believe it.

He should have dropped an egg. Put it down somewhere safe and it'll hatch into a little Prince that thinks you're its parent. Feed it golden apples to help it grow, enchanted ones work even better. And hang on to those King Scales, they make some very nice armor.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
